responsibility: Implements out-of-line construction, copying, and cloning support for Rust HIR statement nodes declared in `rust-hir-stmt.h`. In particular it provides the behavior for `LetStmt` and `ExprStmt`, preserving lowered patterns, optional types, initializer and else expressions, unit-statement flags, source locations, outer attributes, and `Analysis::NodeMapping` when statement subtrees are materialized or duplicated inside block HIR.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementations for statement nodes declared in `rust-hir-stmt.h`, notably constructor, copy, and clone logic for `LetStmt` and `ExprStmt`. Unlike the header, it does not define the abstract `Stmt` API or the statement class layouts.
